description: Change named fields on existing elements. Send only what changes - {id, x: 40} moves one box and leaves its other 25 fields alone. Pass a list in `elements`, each carrying its `id`, or use `ids` + `patch` to apply one change across many.

elements.description: Partial elements, each with an `id` and the fields to change.

label.description: Short description of what this change is doing, e.g. 'add the dog illustration'. Shown next to the snapshot in the history sidebar, which is how the user decides whether to keep or revert it. Always set it.

scene.description: Scene id, exact name, or a unique part of the name. Use list_scenes if unsure.

name: update_elements
